title: 4-7-8 Parasympathetic Breathing
instructions: Inhale through nose for 4s, hold breath for 7s, exhale slowly through mouth for 8s.
benefits: Triggers vagus nerve activation, rapidly lowering elevated heart rate and cortisol levels.

title: Body Scan Mindfulness Meditation
instructions: Lie comfortably, slowly bring conscious awareness to each body part from toes to head releasing tension.
benefits: Improves deep sleep percentage and CNS recovery score prior to sleep.
